evidence: Full tank_core package test suite passes with zero failures across all unit and integration test binaries. cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings clean. cargo fmt --all --check clean.

All 23 substrate unit tests pass, covering every acceptance criterion: rooted_plants_increase_o2_penetration, root_oxygenation_proportional_to_biomass_with_diminishing_returns, floating_plant_biomass_does_not_increase_penetration, zero_root_biomass_yields_zero_oxygenation_bonus, root_oxygenation_uses_named_parameter, root_oxygenation_dynamic_tracks_biomass_growth_and_decline, root_oxygenation_requires_rootable_substrate_habitats, zero_rol_rate_removes_rooted_oxygenation_effects.

All 5 root_zone_oxygenation integration tests pass: planted_vs_unplanted_diverge_in_penetration_depth (500h), planted_substrate_denitrification_interaction (500h), root_oxygenation_reduces_hourly_denitrification_when_it_shrinks_suboxic_volume, planted_substrate_nitrification_surface_area (500h with nitrifier/nitrate divergence), tracing_exposes_root_oxygenation.
All 6 habitat geometry probe tests pass (5 probes + summary). cargo clippy -p tank_harness -- -D warnings clean.

ROL formula verified correct (substrate.rs:99-111): bonus = total_depth × (1 - exp(-(active_root_biomass_g × rol_rate_cm_per_g) / total_depth)). Saturating exponential — linear at low biomass, asymptotic to substrate depth. Satisfies the diminishing-returns acceptance criterion.
Only PlantGuild::RootFeedingRosette contributes to active root biomass (substrate.rs:146 guild filter). Floating/epiphytic/fast-stem guilds excluded.
rol_rate_cm_per_g is a named parameter in ProcessParams (process.rs:176-189) with serde default 0.15 cm/g, invariant-checked non-negative, and present in default.toml. Not hardcoded.

Tracing output verified: step_substrate_zones emits structured tracing::debug! at substrate.rs:59-69 with base_penetration_cm, root_oxygenation_bonus_cm, active_root_biomass_g, effective_penetration_cm as separate named fields.
step_substrate_zones returns SubstrateOxygenationBreakdown and engine.rs reuses the returned value for budget metrics — no redundant recomputation at the engine level.

Biofilter probe (fr-4-08002dd1 fix confirmed): Now uses explicit media constants (500 vs 4000 cm²), asserts nitrifier_large > nitrifier_small (line 448), validates reduced N exposure ordering (line 439), and checks clearance timing. No longer uses a shared floor check. Output shows capacity 0.747->1.278g, reduced-N exposure 1834.70->1696.08.

Redox probe (fr-4-e772c7bf fix confirmed): Denitrifier activity seeded at 0.1 (line 917) via shared configure_redox_baseline, not 1.0. Asserts planted_final_activity > planted_initial_activity + 0.25 (line 1136) to exercise maturation ramp. Asserts inert_final_activity < inert_initial_activity (line 1145) to exercise decay. Output shows activity 0.10->0.40 (planted) and 0.10->0.05 (inert).

Planted substrate confound (fr-4-d4d1e581 fix confirmed): DECOMPOSER_BIOMASS_G = 10.0 is a shared constant applied identically to both arms via configure_redox_baseline (line 920). Planted arm has live RootFeedingRosette plants at 6.0g biomass (lines 988-994). Inert arm depth reduced to 1.0cm (line 1009) for full oxygenation. Plant biomass zeroed only in inert arm (lines 1022-1024). Test validates presence of live rooted plants and PlantSurfaces habitat area (line 1109).
findings_or_gaps: Minor: from_parts (engine.rs:132) discards the SubstrateOxygenationBreakdown returned by step_substrate_zones during initialization. Harmless since init-time tracing isn't needed, but a minor API inconsistency. Non-blocking.

Minor: root_oxygenation_active_biomass_g() internally calls compute_habitat_registry() on each invocation, and substrate_oxygenation_breakdown() also calls this function, creating a redundant registry computation within the substrate module. Non-blocking — the computation is cheap and the engine-level double-computation was already fixed.
follow_up_or_amendments: No blocking amendments required. All acceptance criteria are satisfied with passing tests, clean clippy, and clean formatting across both tank_core and tank_harness packages. The three final-review amendments (biofilter scaling, redox maturation, planted substrate confound) have all been properly addressed in this round.
